Kakkalla,_Kakvalla
a distinguished scholar a. whose instance Guṇacandra wrote his [Page110-a. Haima-vibhramasūtraṭīkā,

Kakkasūri

Kakkāṭṭurājavarṇana

An edn. of it based on 3 mss. (Mathura, 17th cent.; Rewa, 18th cent. an. Ayodhyā 19th cent.) being ptd. by Vishwa Vidyalaya Prakashan, Varanasi.
Kākabhusuṇḍa is counted a. one among the Siddhas in the Tamil Siddha tradition an. three Advaitic mystic poems an. a story about him are found in Tamil literature.
